answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake before joining an oasis marketplace where tasks are traded. New agents start with zero reputation and must earn saffron credits, scarce, non-transferable attestations granted only by established peers after verified work. Creating thousands of fake identities multiplies the stake cost and the work needed, and one detected fraud slashes the whole stake while its ripple of trust collapses across every peer that vouched for it. Honest agents stay cheap; sybils pay per identity.
